parent: ROC-02 original frozen source and ROC-02E failed rank-7 causal gate, main after #147
purpose: Test whether more training at identical architecture and exact train families produces task-competent recurrent checkpoints before further observer mechanism claims

data.sealed_access: forbidden even for smoke; materialize only train/calibration

pilot.init: torch.manual_seed(seed), independent of ROC-02 original six seeds
pilot.sampler: torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed+20261116); same with-replacement randint across 1024 training rows
pilot.resource: local CPU single thread, no paid accelerator

pilot_gate.pass_if: At final 1920 steps, train accuracy >=0.90 and calibration-family accuracy >=0.70; report both cross entropy, 8-way correct-class accuracy and exact source hashes
pilot_gate.if_pass: preregister and run six new independent seeds at depths 8/16 under the identical budget; keep sealed test untouched until all model/observer choices locked
pilot_gate.if_fail: publish actual final metrics and negative pilot outcome; next architecture change must be a dated separately registered protocol
pilot_gate.no_gate_selection: No checkpoint is selected using calibration performance; interim dev results are descriptive and final step 1920 is fixed

controls.avoid: observer gamma fitting, causal manipulation or ROC mechanism classifications at ROC03A stage

statistics: Single initialization pilot is feasibility only. No probability value or generalization claim. Unit of replication in any later stage is model seed.
provenance: Output source split SHA, model checkpoint SHA, full step metrics and one model/seed receipt; on any mismatch abort
publication: Commit protocol before running new model; complete reproducible CPU code and receipt on PR; report FAIL when under gate
